profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Recurve
profile.summary: I am a first generation college student, dreamer as well as a full stack engineer.  My strengths are in the following programming languages, Javascript and Python, as well many frameworks, Flask, React/Redux, Express.js, SQLAchemy, Sequelize and many more.  Computer Science has always been something that intrigued me, especially in the way that you receive instant gratification from solving an issue and seeing the results in real time.

positions.title: Hiring and Training Manager
positions.description:
Pioneered an administrative department to recruit, hire, and train new hires as well as increase employee retention.

Develop and maintain the profiles of all new hires to comply with HIPAA and insurance compliances’.

Provide a 1-week, 32-hour, training to new hires to help with learning the fundamentals of ABA and track their progress to help with them transition into 1:1 therapy

positions.title: Behavioral Health Technician
positions.description:
Provided individual ABA Therapy in-home and center, while implementing individualized treatment plans and goals that are developed by BCBA’s

​​Collected data on various programs and behaviors to monitor progress and overall effectiveness of treatment plans

positions.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
positions.description:
Test iPad OS application and formulate step-by-step detailed reports on software bugs that are then troubleshooted by the software development team

Collaborated and explained report findings in weekly meetings with the rest of my colleagues to help distinguish more effective forms of testing the quality of the application

projects.title: Culturegram
projects.description: This is a clone of the popular website, Instagram. We currently have full CRUD features on Posts and comments. Have a liking system to be able to like and unlike posts and show how many likes a post has.

projects.title: HeirBnb
projects.description: HeirBnB is a clone of Airbnb, this application allows you to search for places to go and enjoy a great time. You are also able to host your own places.
